concurrency: Exactly one writer per run; append and finalize are serialized within that writer; the reader is a separate read-only stage.
inputs: validated events from the unit-3/4/8/9 validation path
outputs: atomic open/closed/failed manifest with artifact index, event count/hash, obligations and evidence status
purpose: Append validated events to one versioned canonical JSONL stream and publish an atomic JSON manifest carrying the artifact index, writer state, event count/hash, caller obligations and an explicit evidence status; claim complete evidence only when every required obligation and integrity check passes.
state: Owns the append-only JSONL stream and the manifest lifecycle, the authoritative event count/stream hash and the published evidence status until a successor supersedes the run.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; canonical serialization flags and the temporary-file/fsync/os.replace publication sequence are present
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned writer/schema sources plus a check that canonical serialization uses sort_keys=True, compact separators and allow_nan=False and that the manifest is written through a temporary file, flush/fsync and os.replace
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

static_checks.expected: ast analysis finds one publication function containing the canonical-length comparison and the temp-file/fsync/os.replace sequence, with no direct os.replace of manifest.json elsewhere
static_checks.rule: exactly one manifest publication chokepoint serializes the candidate manifest and compares the actual canonical byte length against max_manifest_bytes before writing a temporary file and calling os.replace; open, finalize and abort all route their publication through that single chokepoint
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

title: ARGUS2-SR-002-U unit specification - Versioned event stream and atomic run manifest

unit_cases.expected: events.jsonl contains exactly one line terminated by a single \n; the line is canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=False); eventCount is 1
unit_cases.precondition: an open run and one valid event

unit_cases.expected: manifest.json parses; writerState is 'open'; evidenceStatus is 'unassessed'; eventStream bytes/sha256 equal the current events.jsonl
manifest.writerState is 'closed'; evidenceStatus is 'complete'; evidenceReasons is empty; artifact index, byte sizes and content hashes verify against the stream
unit_cases.precondition: a run whose declared required obligations are all satisfied and whose indexed artifacts verify

unit_cases.expected: writerState is 'closed'; evidenceStatus is 'incomplete'; evidenceReasons contains ARGUS2-REASON-UNMET-OBLIGATION and ARGUS2-REASON-UNRESOLVED-CAUSATION
unit_cases.precondition: a run with a required causal-closure obligation left unmet

unit_cases.expected: evidenceStatus is 'incomplete'; evidenceReasons contains ARGUS2-REASON-MISSING-ARTIFACT; a diagnostic with code ARGUS2-MISSING-ARTIFACT is reported
unit_cases.precondition: an indexed artifact deleted after finalize began

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-CORRUPT-STREAM-TRUNCATED; evidenceReasons contains ARGUS2-REASON-TRUNCATED-STREAM; evidenceStatus stays 'incomplete'; the truncated record is not counted as an accepted event
unit_cases.precondition: the final JSONL line left without its terminating newline

unit_cases.expected: evidenceStatus is 'incomplete'; evidenceReasons contains ARGUS2-REASON-KNOWN-LOSS; finalization alone never yields 'complete'
unit_cases.precondition: an imported observation whose counters.dropped is greater than zero

unit_cases.expected: writerState is 'closed' while evidenceStatus is 'incomplete'; both facts are reported independently and no success, validity or readiness claim follows
entry carries run-relative path, mediaType, schemaVersion, integer bytes, lowercase sha256 and role; entries are unique by path
unit_cases.precondition: a run that records one owned artifact

unit_cases.expected: manifest.eventCount equals the accepted line count; eventStream.bytes equals the file size; eventStream.sha256 equals the recomputed SHA-256
unit_cases.precondition: a run with several appended events

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-SCHEMA-MAJOR-UNSUPPORTED with a bounded partial result; the original manifest bytes are unchanged
unit_cases.precondition: a manifest whose schemaVersion major is not 1

unit_cases.expected: the unknown extensions namespace is echoed verbatim and never interpreted, and it does not affect status, ordering or obligations

recordedEvidenceStatus/recordedEvidenceReasons echo the manifest verbatim, assessedEvidenceStatus/assessedEvidenceReasons are computed by the reader and reported as the primary status, and the two are never conflated (ARGUS2-ADV-03)
unit_cases.precondition: an intact finalized run whose manifest recorded evidenceStatus 'complete'

unit_cases.expected: recorded status stays 'complete' only as a recorded fact while assessedEvidenceStatus is 'incomplete' with ARGUS2-REASON-TRUNCATED-STREAM/ARGUS2-REASON-CORRUPT-EVENT; the export never presents primary complete (ARGUS2-ADV-03)
unit_cases.precondition: a manifest that recorded 'complete' whose stream tail was truncated after finalize

unit_cases.expected: assessedEvidenceStatus is 'incomplete' with ARGUS2-REASON-CORRUPT-MANIFEST; recorded claims are carried only as recorded facts and the primary status is never complete (ARGUS2-ADV-03)
unit_cases.precondition: a structurally invalid manifest (or one with a wrong-typed frozen member) that also claims 'complete'

unit_cases.expected: the finalize publication is refused with ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_manifest_bytes; the prior open manifest bytes remain on disk; the writer does not report 'closed'/'complete' (ARGUS2-ADV-06)
unit_cases.precondition: a caller max_manifest_bytes sized so the open manifest fits but the finalize manifest (artifact index, obligations and finalized metadata) exceeds it
